messages:
claire: heads up, I opened a micro-PR to introduce a Go SDK example and a short 'scale-down smoothing' paragraph for Dedicated provisioning docs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1688

claire: ask: keep wording clear that smoothing delays aggressive scale-downs to avoid oscillation when bursty traffic subsides; include YAML + Go snippet and a compact 429 payload for callers.

oso: love the idea. can we show both 'smoothing_window_seconds' and an example of the CLI that applies the policy? keeps ops folks happy.

ryan: adding a suggested YAML:
```yaml
scale_policy:
  mode: autoscale
  smoothing_window_seconds: 45
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  queue_limit: 350
  fallback_policy: "reserved_pool_fallback"
```

ryan: and a one-line explanation: "Smoothing window postpones scale-downs for short dips so the autoscaler doesn't thrash capacity. If saturation persists beyond smoothing + cooldown, fallback evaluation may trigger eviction per policy."

meera: Go SDK snippet for the PR body:
```go
import "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
client := sdk.NewClient()
policy := sdk.ScalePolicy{
  Mode: "autoscale",
  SmoothingWindowSeconds: 45,
  CooldownSeconds: 60,
  QueueLimit: 350,
  FallbackPolicy: "reserved_pool_fallback",
}
client.SetScalePolicy("tenant-7", policy)
```

meera: note: the Go SDK currently uses camelCase fields; I'll include both variants in the sample to reduce copy/paste errors.

docs-bot: linkcheck: found one broken anchor -> #scale-down-behavior (line 103)

claire: thanks bot. fixing anchor to #smoothing-and-fallback in the branch now.

oso: product note: add a short expected latency line near the snippet: "expected scale-up latency: ~150ms warm, 800ms-3s cold" so PMs can set UX expectations.

ryan: +1. also adding a compact 429 example for error handling:
```json
{
  "error": "queue_saturated",
  "status": 429,
  "retry_after_seconds": 30
}
```

meera: i18n: please add translator context for the smoothing sentence and the 429 payload; I'll add comments in the PR. e.g. // context: smoothing prevents flapping; translate as operational guidance not SLA.

claire: plan: meera will add Go field variant examples and i18n comments, ryan will add the product latency line and fix the wording to 'may trigger eviction', oso will do a quick CLI example, I will squash+merge after CI green. target: tomorrow morning. :rocket:
